meta.name: boardroom
meta.description: /cs:boardroom <brief> — 6-phase multi-role deliberation across the C-suite with Phase 2 isolation, critic pre-screen, and synthesis. Outputs a board memo. Use when a decision spans multiple executive domains — e.g. a pricing change touching finance, positioning, and product, or a raise-vs-cut runway call.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 模拟高管团队进行多角色决策讨论并生成纪要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要模拟C-level讨论来辅助复杂决策
copy.tagline_en: Simulate C-suite deliberation across roles and generate a board memo
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-role executive deliberation to support complex decisions

howto.what: Claude 会模拟一个由多位高管顾问组成的董事会，对战略议题进行6阶段讨论，最终生成一份包含投票、异议和决策建议的董事会备忘录。
howto.when: 当你使用命令 /cs:boardroom 并附上一个战略简报文件路径时触发。适用于涉及多个高管领域（如财务、产品、市场）的决策。

say.text: 用 /cs:boardroom 分析我们是否应该提价。
say.note: 触发董事会讨论定价策略。

say.text: 运行 /cs:boardroom 评估融资还是削减成本。
say.note: 触发关于资金决策的董事会讨论。

howto.what_en: Claude simulates a board of C-suite advisors to deliberate a strategic brief in 6 phases, producing a board memo with votes, dissents, and decision recommendations.
howto.when_en: Triggered by the command /cs:boardroom followed by a brief file path. Use when a decision spans multiple executive domains like finance, product, and marketing.

say_en.text: Run /cs:boardroom to analyze whether we should raise prices.
say_en.note: Triggers board deliberation on pricing strategy.

say_en.text: Execute /cs:boardroom to evaluate raise vs. cut runway.
say_en.note: Triggers board discussion on funding decision.
